title: Squadron 42 Delayed to 2027 Because of GTA6
description: Cloud Imperium Games has delayed Squadron 42 to Q2 2027, with studio boss Chris Roberts citing concerns that the game would be drowned out by GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Squadron 42 Pushed to 2027 as Developer Fears Being Overshadowed by GTA6

The sheer gravitational pull of Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to reshape the gaming calendar. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, Cloud Imperium Games (CIG) has decided to delay its long-in-development Star Citizen spin-off, Squadron 42, to the second quarter of 2027.

The rationale behind this significant delay boils down to market competition and the unavoidable dominance of Grand Theft Auto VI. Studio boss Chris Roberts openly argued that releasing the title too close to GTA6 would risk the game being completely drowned out by the unprecedented hype and attention surrounding Rockstar's mega-release.

### Navigating the Shadow of a Giant

As one of the most anticipated entertainment launches in history, GTA6 has effectively forced surrounding developers to carefully strategize their release windows. Competing for consumer wallets and media coverage against a title of that magnitude is a perilous undertaking for any studio. By pushing Squadron 42 into 2027, CIG is opting for a safer runway, ensuring that their ambitious sci-fi project has breathing room to capture the audience it needs.

While the ongoing development saga of the Star Citizen universe continues to draw varied reactions from the gaming community, this latest scheduling shift highlights just how disruptive the arrival of GTA6 is proving to be across the entire industry.

## Editor's Take

It speaks volumes about the industry dominance of GTA6 that other massive, long-awaited projects are actively rearranging their launch windows just to avoid getting swallowed by its hype wave. CIG's decision is a pragmatic one, proving that in the era of Rockstar's upcoming titan, survival often means stepping entirely out of the way.
